principle: Accepted progress and incremental selection value matter more than provider-call count. Full-pool paid inference is not a daily objective.

historical_cny_2_per_member.meaning: Temporary upper ceiling for a valid member whose dry envelope could not fit the default CNY0.10 pre-send cap.

daily_cny_65_70.meaning: Hard mathematical ceiling for a hypothetical 657-member full calibration scan at CNY0.10/member, not a target spend and not a default daily budget.

observed_cost_reference.note: Projection is descriptive only; actual future token mix/provider pricing may differ.

R0_ONLY.purpose: Refresh the entire official/operational universe, prices, technical facts, eligibility, change features and evidence freshness without paid model inference.

CALIBRATION_FULL.purpose: Occasional full-pool benchmark to measure selective-router recall, ranking drift and false-negative risk. Not routine production.

SELECTIVE.paid_population: Only calibrated shortlist plus audit sample.
SELECTIVE.formal_O_claim: PROHIBITED until selector calibration is accepted.

hard_rules: No selective production promotion until at least 5 accepted full-scan calibration sessions exist.
If any calibration session contains O BUY/action_family=buy, selector recall of every such BUY must be 100%.
Across calibration sessions, selector must retain at least 95% of full-scan Top10 members.
Excluded-bucket audit sample must be retained each session to estimate false negatives.
If false-negative evidence or material ranking drift exceeds the accepted tolerance, revert to R0_ONLY or CALIBRATION_FULL.
selective_acceptance.outcome_rule: Selector promotion should also compare forward 1/3/5/10/20-session outcomes of retained vs missed names; ranking recall alone is not evidence of better trading win rate.

spend_priority: 1. Full-universe deterministic data quality and freshness.
2. Paid inference on names most likely to change the decision frontier.
3. Independent evidence verification on the final actionable shortlist.
4. Occasional full scans only to calibrate and audit the selector.
prohibited: Do not spend paid inference merely to achieve a 657/657 activity count.
Do not inherit the historical CNY2/member closure ceiling into daily production.
Do not loosen BUY semantics to reduce costs or force trades.
Do not claim full-universe formal O ranking from a selective subset before calibration acceptance.
